audience: sales, marketing and recruiting teams who look up people and companies in People Data Labs

useCases.title: Enrich a person from an email or name
useCases.text: The AI sends identifying details such as name, email, phone, profile URL or company and gets the best-matching profile with a likelihood score from 1 to 10.

useCases.title: Find possible matches from unclear person details
useCases.text: When the details are broad or unclear, the AI gets up to 20 related profiles ranked by match score. You pick the right person.

useCases.title: Search people by job role, company or place
useCases.text: The AI searches the person dataset with a query, for example everyone with a given job role at a company. It can check valid search values with autocomplete first.

useCases.title: Look up a company's size, industry and location
useCases.text: The AI finds one company by name, website, ticker or profile and returns firmographics such as industry, size and location.

useCases.title: Find companies by size, industry and country
useCases.text: The AI searches the company dataset, for example SaaS companies with 50 to 200 employees in the US, and lists the matches.

useCases.title: Find which company is behind an IP address
useCases.text: The AI matches an IP address and returns its location and company, and optionally related person data.
